title: Gemini, say the plain sentence
caption: eleven tabs open, one sentence unsaid

scenes.text: gemini, close the other tab for a second.
mercury handed you every word in the language.
you can talk to anyone about anything until three a.m.
the funny one, the curious one, the one with a plan.
and somehow nobody quite knows which one is you.
the twins aren't a flaw. you are more than one thing.
but a joke is a door you close very politely.
and you've gotten so good at closing it.
next time, try the sentence you'd usually laugh off.
the plain one. the 'i like you and it scares me' one.
say the honest thing before the clever one.
being known is the one conversation you haven't had.
